author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a woven diamond lattice with four even cells, round ear loops on its side corners, and a hanging cord ending in an arched tassel; reads as a Chinese decorative knot, symmetric about x=24.
omissions: The source's lattice has more crossings and six ear loops; at 48px one crossing (2x2 cells) and two side loops are the most that keep 8-unit cell and loop clearances. The tassel is a single arch.
drawing_plan: Diamond half-diagonal 12 about (24,18), cords from side midpoints crossing at the centre, r3 ear loops at the side corners, cord and r4 tassel arch below.
